title: Contrarian Market Trajectory Probe and Procurement Heuristic
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a practical, repeatable procurement heuristic and signal pipeline that flags 'contrarian' model supply trajectories (sudden availability shocks, stealth degradations, or rapid entrant surges) and produces prioritized remediation playbooks for procurement and SRE. Scope covers hosted + dedicated + private model variants for low-latency verticals (search, RAG, chat) and produces: 1) a scoring rubric for procurement readiness, 2) a lightweight experiment kit (microbench + synthetic workloads) to validate candidate models, and 3) dashboard + alert templates for operations and sales. This ticket coordinates PM research, field probes, and deliverable definition (not heavy infra changes).
acceptance_criteria: Procurement heuristic spec published: weighted rubric (latency tolerance, quantization compatibility, regional availability, fallback cost) with example scores for 10 models
Field experiment kit: 3 synthetic workloads and automation scripts (bench harness) documented in Drive and runnable by Solutions Eng
Dashboard mock for watchtower: latency/availability spike view + prioritized remediation actions (canary switch, downgrade quant, route to alternate region)
Pilot run completed on 2 enterprise customers' workloads with initial scoring and a short readout (lessons + next steps)
Hand-off doc and onboarding checklist for Sales/SEs and SRE/Capacity teams
tasks: Assemble competitive signal list (availability, cadence, release artifacts) for 12 candidate models
Define scoring weights and justify via customer impact profiles
Design 3 synthetic workloads representative of latency-sensitive customers
Build microbench harness + param file and validate on runtime-1.18 and runtime-1.20
Prototype procurement dashboard mock in Figma and a minimal Kibana/Grafana layout
Coordinate 2 pilot runs with Solutions Eng and capture telemetry and customer feedback
Write and publish the procurement heuristic spec to Confluence (including integration notes for Watchtower alerts)
